description.value: Christine Sinclair Community Centre is a City of Burnaby recreation facility named after Canadian soccer icon Christine Sinclair, situated in the Burnaby Lake 'sports central' hub alongside sports fields and ice arenas. Formerly known as Fortius Sport & Health, it was rebranded as part of Burnaby's community recreation network and offers state-of-the-art fitness amenities including cardio and weight rooms, a gymnasium, and a steam room. Its central location near Bill Copeland Sports Centre makes it a substantial recreation node for the eastern Burnaby area.
